transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
Well, I've got a cough, and I've been having pain on the right side of my abdomen. It started two days ago.
Do you have any allergies or bad reactions to any medicines?
No, I've never had any allergies or bad reactions to medicines that I know of.
How bad is the pain on the right side of your abdomen?
The pain only comes on when I cough — if I'm not coughing, I don't feel it. I couldn't really give you a number for how bad it is.
Could you tell me about any medicines you take, including any new or changed ones?
I do take tablets, but I can't remember the names of them offhand. Nothing new or changed, as far as I know.
Have you ever had any operations?
No, I haven't had any operations.
Along with the cough and the pain, have you noticed anything else that's different or bothering you?
Yes, I've been having aches all over my body, and I've been feeling nauseous too. I've also felt feverish with chills at home — my forehead felt warm.
What worries you most about what's been going on?
Well, I had pneumonia last year and it cleared up, so I suppose I'm a bit worried this could be something like that again.
Can you tell me what that pain in your belly feels like?
I'm not sure how to describe it really — it's just a pain that comes on when I cough, on the right side. Otherwise I don't feel it at all.
Is there anything else about your health in the past that you'd like to tell me about?
Yes, I have high blood pressure, and I also have macular degeneration in my eyes.
Is there anything else you'd like to add about the medicines you take?
No, that's really all I can tell you — I just know I take tablets for my blood pressure and such, but I can't remember the names.
How have your usual daily activities been going for you lately?
I've been managing, though the aches and feeling unwell have made things a bit harder than usual the last couple of days. Nothing else really stands out.
Is there anything else you’ve noticed along with the cough and the pain in the right side of your tummy?
No, I think that's everything — just the aches, the nausea, and feeling feverish with chills.
Is there anything else about your past health you'd like to add?
No, I think that's all — just the high blood pressure, the macular degeneration, and that bout of pneumonia last year.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
